overview: A single cross-reference sheet directing researchers to file 894.7961/7 for document no. 69, a communication from Neville dated February 26, 1931. The referenced document concerns the U.S. Department of State’s distinction between the legal status of the Kwantung Leased Territory and that of the South Manchuria Railway Zone, raised by Japanese efforts to restrict flights by foreign aviators over the railway zone.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to Neville document no. 69 on Kwantung and South Manchuria Railway territories
subfiles.about: The sheet refers researchers to document no. 69 in file 894.7961/7 concerning the differing legal status of the Kwantung Leased Territory and the South Manchuria Railway Zone.
subfiles.summary: This filing note records a February 26, 1931 communication from Neville and directs readers to file 894.7961/7. The referenced communication explains that the Department of State consistently distinguished between the legal status of the Kwantung Leased Territory and that of the South Manchuria Railway Zone. The issue arose from a Japanese attempt to restrict flights by foreign aviators over the railway zone.

interest: Although the substantive communication is filed elsewhere, this sheet preserves an important archival link between territorial-jurisdiction questions and the regulation of foreign aviation in Japanese-controlled Manchuria. It is useful evidence of the State Department’s insistence that Japan’s leasehold rights in Kwantung and its rights in the South Manchuria Railway Zone were legally distinct, and it identifies the precise related file and document number needed to reconstruct the fuller exchange.
